The attack came as Russia was holding the second day of its three-day State Duma elections, the country’s first parliamentary vote since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

Multiple videos posted to social media purport to show the Moscow Oil Refinery in the Kapotnya district of the capital ablaze after several drone strikes.

"An Astra analysis of eyewitness footage indicates that the Moscow refinery was among the targets of the attack," independent Russian outlet Astra reported.

"The city's mayor had previously confirmed an attack on one of the plant's facilities but stated that there were no casualties," it added.
